headline: Deadly protests deepen crisis in Pakistan-administered Kashmir
summary: The BBC reports violent clashes in Rawalakot, where families describe deaths and political demands remain unresolved.
script: In Rawalakot, Pakistan-administered Kashmir, protests have turned deadly. Families describe violence and grief as security forces and demonstrators remain locked in a wider political crisis.
imageAlt: A person holds the hand of a victim on a hospital bed.
imageAltTwo: A road outside Rawalakot is blocked by fallen trees and debris.
